whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Kallisto Rooftop Restaurant & Cafe,

I noticed your cafe has a stellar 5.0★ rating in Kankarbagh, but your current Jimdo site still has default placeholder text like "Say what you do in 2 or 3 sentences" instead of your actual menu and ambiance.

Maine aapke rooftop cafe ke liye ek custom professional website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table reservation, food gallery, aur rooftop dining vibe integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://kallisto-rooftop-restaurant-and-cafe-3.jimdosite.com/

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Kallisto Rooftop, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke rooftop restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! Humne ise specifically aapke Kankarbagh location ke liye design kiya hai jisme direct table booking aur food gallery hai. Aapko overall look kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items aur real photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
